# dsh-pijul
Pijul distributed version control inside DeepSeek Harness — inspect, record, channel, push and pull
without leaving the chat.
## What changes after installing
The agent gains sixteen tools that drive the `pijul` CLI through the harness `shell` service, under
the calling session's standing sandbox policy and working directory:
| Tool | What it does |

| `pijul_status` | Working-copy state: current channel, unrecorded changes, untracked files |
| `pij

ul_log` | Recorded changes, newest first (`limit`, `offset`) |
| `pijul_diff` | Unrecorded changes a

s hunks, optionally limited to paths |
| `pijul_init` | Create a repository |
| `pijul_clone` | Clon

e from a URL, SSH target or local path |
| `pijul_add` | Start tracking paths (`recursive` to includ

e directory contents) |
| `pijul_record` | Record a change with a message, non-interactively |
| `pi

jul_change` | Show one change by hash or unambiguous prefix |
| `pijul_unrecord` | Drop changes from

the current channel — Pijul's undo |
| `pijul_reset` | Discard unrecorded working-copy changes |
|

`pijul_push` | Push to a remote (`--all` by default) |
| `pijul_pull` | Pull from a remote (`--all`

by default) |
| `pijul_remote` | List remotes, set the default, delete one |
| `pijul_channel` | Lis

t, create, switch, delete or fork channels |
| `pijul_apply` | Apply recorded changes to the current

channel |
| `pijul_identity` | List the signing identities pijul knows about |
Every tool returns `{ ok, exitCode, timedOut, aborted, stdout, stderr }`, and renders as a compact `
[tool] ok/failed` block. `repo` defaults to the session working directory, so inside a repository ch
lock. `repo` defaults to the session working directory, so inside a repository chat you can omit it.

.

## Non-interactivity
A pijul command that opens an editor does not just fail an agent — it blocks the tool until the shel
l timeout. The plugin is built so that cannot happen, and the two cases it must defend against were
found by probing `1.0.0-beta.21`:
| pijul behaviour | How the plugin handles it |
| `pijul record <paths> -m <msg>` opens the commit-message editor **even though `-m` was given** (in
every flag order) | The command preamble exports `EDITOR`/`VISUAL` as the shell builtin `true`, a n
o-op. pijul then accepts the template it already wrote — the `-m` message — instead of waiting on an

editor. |
| `pijul push` / `pijul pull` without `--all` open the editor to pick changes | `--all` i
s the default, and the same no-op editor makes the explicit `all: false` escape hatch safe rather th

an hanging. |
| `pijul unrecord` with no hashes shows an interactive selection | `pijul_unrecord` re

quires at least one hash. |
| `pijul add .` records only the directory itself, **not its contents**
| `pijul_add` exposes `recursive` (pijul `--recursive`); the tool description says so, because "add
everything" is the common intent. |
The plugin never prompts, and it never leaves a process attached to a terminal.
## Permissions and compatibility
- **Permissions**: commands run through the harness `shell` service under the calling session's stan
ding sandbox policy — the same confinement as the built-in `bash` tool. Repositories are read and wr
itten under the session workspace; the SSH agent is used only to sign recorded changes. The plugin m
akes no network calls of its own: `pijul clone`/`push`/`pull` reach the network only when you invoke

them.
- **External services**: none. Fully offline for local repositories.
- **Compatibility**: Dee
pSeek Harness profiles built on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` (DSH `>=0.2.0 <0.3.0`). It uses `tools`, `sh
ell` and `systemPrompt`, and reads `sandboxPolicy`, `shellEnv` and `workingDirectory` when the profi

le provides them. pijul `1.0.0-beta.x`.
- **HTTPS remotes** support clone and pull but not push; use
SSH or a local path to push.
## Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Cause and fix |
| `pijul binary not found on PATH` | Install pijul, or set `config.binary` to an absolute path on th

e `pijul` row. |
| `pijul_record` fails with an SSH or identity error | Recording is signed. Run `pi

jul_identity`; start the agent at `~/.ssh/agent.sock` and `ssh-add` your key (see Requirements). |
|
`Error: Already in a Pijul repository` | `pijul_init` on a directory that already holds a repositor

y. That is a pijul error with exit 1, not a no-op. |
| `Refusing to reset, as there are unrecorded c

hanges` | `pijul_reset` first, or record them, before switching channels. |
| A tool reports `sandbo
x: file access denied` | The session's sandbox policy governs the repository path; widen the workspa
ce or move the repository inside it. |
On some systems the distro/snap `pijul` package cannot run inside a container because it hard-codes
an `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` under a read-only `/run`; a plain binary (`cargo install` or a release tarball)
is the reliable choice.
